recent_milestones.text: Lian antimony-halide contribution published and anonymously verified: three synthesis routes or variants, 21 illustrated operations, 53 selected source crops and two qualified partial bulk-crystal views. Dataset 0.27.0 contains 546 records, 106 routes and 46 material/component pages.

Lian complete source and structured-data audits passed; illustrations remain under review. The completed Morrison slot was refilled with Ghosh (2012), on giant CdSe/CdS quantum dots. Both retain distinct review and publication gates.

Morrison CdSe/CdS contribution published and anonymously verified: 2 synthesis routes, 8 supporting procedures and 8 observation records. Dataset 0.26.0 has 530 records, 103 routes/variants and 44 material/component hubs.

The completed Evans slot was refilled from the screened fixed collection with Lian (2021), on antimony halides. Morrison illustrations continue in parallel. The latest folder scan found 13,984 document copies; later-arrival papers remain outside the fixed deadline collection.

Evans complete main/SI contribution published and anonymously verified: dataset 0.25.0, 512 records, 101 routes/variants and 44 material/component collections. All 46 operation controls and the species 9 viewer were checked; the molecular CIF is not a quantum-dot structure. Morrison source and structured-data audits passed; illustrations continue.

Evans apparatus audit passed all 46 scenes and 153 conditions. Morrison complete source extraction was frozen after all 27 main/SI pages and 30 selected crops were inspected; independent scientific review remains active. No new scientific records published by this progress update.

Evans structured records/reader and molecular source bindings passed separate audits. Forty-six operation diagrams entered independent review. Morrison CdSe/CdS shell-growth paper was admitted through the fixed-cutoff evidence-ranked queue and is being extracted alongside a distinct source reviewer.

Heo contribution published and anonymously verified: dataset 0.24.0, 480 records, 98 routes/variants and 44 material/component collections. The complete 1,209-row SI reader and qualified average-occupancy CIF are included; the original five-paper pilot is 5/5 published.
Heo molecular identities and exact material/stock bindings passed their scoped independent audit after a source-page locator correction. Canonical corrections and website integration remain pending.

Corpus screening refreshed and fixed-cutoff selection activated. A rolling review slot admitted Evans 2010 alongside Heo; original four published batch contributions and their audits remain unchanged.
Heo complete SI aggregation and average-position/occupancy model passed scoped independent checks. Two SI signs and source geometry/recipe discrepancies remain explicit.
Latest saved corpus scan found 13,786 document copies across the incoming and original collections; 9,469 provisional scopes were waiting and one paper was active.
GitHub Pages dataset 0.23.0 published: 470 records and 42 material/component collections. Nagasaki, Ribeiro and Norberg contributions added 46 records.

workflow.summary: Screen the fixed collection first, prioritize usable synthesis evidence, and review papers in parallel with a separate independent audit for each.
workflow.screening_scope: The fixed-cutoff screen accounts for all 13,831 top-level document copies: 13,593 text-screened candidates and 238 manual format/text cases. Three nested PDFs were separately screened and remain held for identity reconciliation. Later arrivals stay outside the fixed completion target. Screening is not full reading or a no-recipe exclusion.
steps: Preserve stable filenames and verify main-paper/SI associations against content and hashes.
Use synthesis and structure evidence to rank papers; retain partial recipes, unsuccessful outcomes and unresolved cases.
Extract one paper while a different reviewer audits another. Every contribution retains its own source, sample and figure checks.
Generate academic readers from reviewed records and reusable illustrations, checking each source-specific condition and chemical identity.
Publish completed, independently passed contributions together; leave unfinished papers in review.
workflow.capacity: Up to five active paper claims; current runtime supports four simultaneous agents including the coordinating agent. These are different limits. Completed members can free review slots while earlier work continues.
workflow.paid_processing: The paid API pilot is deferred. Work continues with the existing local setup.

estimate.summary: The two-month target covers the fixed existing collection. 9,508 provisional cutoff scopes remain pending, plus three nested identity cases. Roughly 159 closures per day over 60 days, or 190 per day over 50 production days, would be required. Achievable capacity and the recipe-bearing fraction remain unverified.
estimate.current_batch: The retained pilot and Evans, Morrison and Lian rolling contributions are published. Ghosh data and illustrations proceed in parallel with distinct audits. Full-corpus completion and target throughput remain unverified.
notes: A closure is either an independently evidenced no-recipe exclusion or a retained contribution passing reading, extraction, audit, website and publication checks.
The frozen collection has 13,831 top-level document copies and three nested document candidates. File copies, provisional scopes and synthesis recipes are different counts.
Later-arrival papers remain separate. Late or changed supporting information for an included paper reopens the relevant review.
The paid pilot decision is deferred. Screening speed cannot be used as the detailed-review rate; throughput will be updated from completed audited contributions.
